title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates (0.0312, 0.0312) with a radius of 0.0312. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0288. Apply a scale factor of 0.0625 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it according to the Euler angles and translating it based on the translation vector previously defined. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid cylindrical body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.0625 units in length, 0.0625 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0312, 0.0312)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0312)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0288)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

wall = 0.005
height = 0.75

    cq.Workplane("XY")

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Draw the first circular feature
r = r.circle(0.0312)  # radius

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Create a cutout along the length of the cylinder
cutout_height = 0.75  # total height of the cylinder
cutout_radius = 0.0312  # radius of the cylinder
cutout_width = 0.01  # width of the cutout
cutout = cq.Workplane("YZ").box(cutout_width, 2*cutout_radius, cutout_height, centered=(False, True, True))

# Subtract the cutout from the cylinder
r = r.cut(cutout)
